note: Placeholders share the block editor's format. {{OBJID:kind}} asks for an object of that kind from the scene, {{VAR:name:type}} declares a value, {{TEXT:label}} asks for a strings.json key. The editor turns them into Monaco tab stops, and INSERT SELECTED OBJECT fills an {{OBJID}} from the current scene selection.

snippets.warn: Do not retrigger an emitter that is still sounding. Moving it drags the cue already playing across the map, so pool your emitters and give each about 2.5 seconds before reuse.
